Story & Plot

A falsely accused war hero, Ryan Fang Flanagan, finds himself with nothing left to lose and leads police on an epic, televised cross-country car chase. He receives help from members of his former Special Forces Army battalion along the way. Meanwhile, a fascinated public closely monitors the pursuit and roots for his safe getaway.

Comedy & Entertainment

As a physical, old-school action thriller, the film relies heavily on its high-octane premise rather than explicit comedic moments. Its entertainment value stems from the thrilling dynamic of a televised pursuit and a public rooting for the fugitive. The overall tone remains serious and focused on the tension of the cross-country escape.

Liam Neeson stars in the lead role as the decorated war veteran, delivering a decent performance that anchors the narrative. The cast also features Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames, Michael Chiklis, and Brett Tucker. Together, they support a familiar structure driven by the central character's plight.

The film tends to suffer from a familiar setup that does not significantly reinvent the typical Liam Neeson-style action thriller. Reviewers note that the story and overall structure can feel a bit weak as the narrative progresses, leaning heavily on tropes seen in past genre entries.
